confirmed_static_behaviors.behavior: Reads CF_UNICODETEXT through OpenClipboard/GetClipboardData; when the selected output differs, empties the clipboard and writes replacement Unicode text with SetClipboardData.
Initializes 17 mapping entries: 16 cryptocurrency-related labels and one STEAMLINK entry. Address/link values are redacted from reports and pseudocode.
Hides the console, copies the current executable under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Credentials\WindowsLogonApplication.exe, relaunches it with CREATE_NO_WINDOW, and creates a global mutex.
Queries TokenElevation and relaunches with ShellExecuteExA verb runas when not elevated.
Calls IsDebuggerPresent in exception-handling logic; anti-analysis indicator, not conclusive by itself.

other_artifacts.clean_controller_impl: Metadata identifies Malwarebytes CleanController 3.3.0.919; main EXE has no static import or plaintext filename reference. Authenticode digest validity was not verified.
other_artifacts.settings_json_and_utils_dll: High-entropy opaque blobs; content and role unknown.
